page.overview:
What is Jack Sloper?

Jack Sloper was a wizard and substitute Beater on the Gryffindor Quidditch team in 1995. Along with Andrew Kirke, he took over from Fred Weasley and George Weasley. Jack was unsuccessful in rejoining the team the next year.

Jack began attending Hogwarts in the 1990s and was Sorted into Gryffindor. He joined the Gryffindor Quidditch team as a Beater in 1995, after previous Beaters Fred and George Weasley received a lifetime ban. He was described as incompetent by Captain Angelina Johnson; Jack knocked himself unconscious with his own bat during a training session, and also ended up hitting Angelina in the mouth with his bat during a Quidditch match. Despite initial his lack of skill, Jack's team ended up taking winning the Quidditch cup, indicating, like Ron, he may have started to improve at the end of the season.

He expressed interest in continuing to play for Gryffindor, but was replaced the following year by Ritchie Coote. Jack also delivered a message for Albus Dumbledore to Harry Potter with the details of their first lesson. He also asked Harry when tryouts would be held for Quidditch.

Jack derives from John, a name from Hebrew which means "God is gracious".
